definitions: Of the colour of milk or fresh snow, due to the reflection of all visible rays of light; the opposite of black.
Relating to or denoting a human group having light-coloured skin.
Pale or ashen from fear, illness, or shock.
Having no colour; transparent or clear.
examples: She wore a beautiful white dress.
The white population of the city has decreased.
His face went white with fear.
He was known for his white magic.
The white wine was served chilled.
